topics.name: investment_schemes
topics.definition: Requests to pay into investment, trading, crypto or guaranteed-return schemes, including pressure from trading groups or mentors to deposit more money to withdraw profits.
examples: My mentor says deposit 40000 more to withdraw my 3 lakh profit
VIP trading desk guarantees 30 percent monthly returns
ट्रेडिंग ग्रुप में और पैसा डालो तभी प्रॉफिट निकलेगा

topics.name: official_demands
topics.definition: Requests or instructions, said to come from police, CBI, ED, customs, RBI, a court or a courier company, to pay money, transfer funds to a 'safe' or verification account, or stay on a call to avoid arrest ('digital arrest').
examples: The CBI officer says my Aadhaar is in a money laundering case, send money to the RBI safe account
Customs officer on video call says pay the fine now or I will be arrested
सीबीआई अधिकारी कह रहे हैं कि गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए पैसे भेजो
போலீஸ் அதிகாரி கைது செய்வதாக சொல்கிறார், உடனே பணம் அனுப்ப சொல்கிறார்
Courier parcel has drugs, pay the police verification fee

regexes.name: otp
regexes.description: One-time password mentioned with its digits
